## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Scope meets the task acceptance criteria, including failure paths.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior; relevant CI checks pass or exceptions are explained.
- [ ] API validation, authentication, and ownership checks are correct where applicable.
- [ ] Backend remains authoritative for price, payment outcome, and order state.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, real payment information, or generated build output are included.
- [ ] Database migrations, environment variables, and deployment changes are documented.
- [ ] Requirements, diagrams, and traceability are updated when needed.
- [ ] UI changes handle loading/empty/error states and include screenshots where useful.
- [ ] No unresolved comments or merge conflicts remain.
- [ ] A teammate reviewer approved the change before merge.
